verdicts.justification: The specified Brightwater Shower Set 07SS004 is discontinued. Rule SR-0040 approves the Peralta Shower Set 08SS007, which holds WELS registration W55254-62 at 6.0 stars against the specified 5.5, WaterMark certificate WMKA25198, is project approved, and has 317 units at Melbourne West DC against a requirement of 6.
verdicts.complianceNotes: Finish differs: specified matte black, proposed brushed brass. Flagged for architect confirmation. The superseded-by product MCS-0461 was not proposed: its WELS rating of 3.5 is below the specified 5.5.

verdicts.justification: The specified Thornbury 750mm Cooktop 04CT75002 is discontinued, and none of the 48 eligible cooktops matches the specified cut-out of 750 x 605 x 560mm, so no substitution is proposed.
verdicts.complianceNotes: Escalated: no candidate fits the cut-out. Note the specified product measures 750 x 590 x 560mm, so the schedule dimension itself may need architect confirmation.
